title: Active Slice Discovery in Large Language Models
findings: The study found that identity-based error slices, such as the one for 'christian', can be detected with high accuracy using only a few hundred annotations. This suggests that slices with clear lexical cues are easier to identify with the proposed active slice discovery method compared to more heterogeneous or sentiment-based slices.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the ability of an active learning method to efficiently discover 'error slices' (subsets of data where a model systematically fails) in a toxicity classification task. One of the specific slices evaluated was an identity-based slice related to the term 'christian'.
